AMCAF examples · Local catalogue

Original AMCAF example. Original sample-bank playback, key prompt, PCM-word fix and saved-file download. Compilation and runtime compatibility are reported separately. Select Keyboard: Typing for text prompts.

AMCAF — SamBankFixer.AMOS

Controls

Follow the game's intro and menu prompts. Arrows move; Space/Enter fires. Choose Keyboard: Typing to enter text; switch back to Keyboard: Joystick to play. Gamepad and touch controls work in both modes. Escape leaves fullscreen.

Shift or the gamepad’s right face button is secondary fire. The left face button supplies third fire. Typing mode releases keyboard fire mappings.
